Title: Public Preview: Migrate Oracle databases to Azure HorizonDB using Azure Database Migration Service

Body.Content:
Azure Database Migration Service now supports Oracle-to-Azure HorizonDB data migrations. You can configure source and target connections, select the schemas to migrate, initiate data transfer, and track migration progress through a single experience—without having to build and manage custom data-movement processes.

After converting your Oracle schema using your preferred schema-conversion tools, you can use Azure Database Migration Service to migrate your data to Azure HorizonDB. 

Learn more.
